title: 第二十五章 浴魔功第二十六章 释放
content_zh:
在他的右眼中，扭动的狐狸脑袋是一团灰蒙蒙的雾影。
狐狸凑近了嗅他，鼻翼翕动，嗅了又嗅。
师春也嗅到了香气的来源，正是眼前的狐妖，他笑容越发谄媚，混合体内煎熬的痛苦，笑的确实不太好看。
下一刻他就笑不出来了，笑容僵在了脸上，那青狐大妖竟向他露出了可怕的獠牙。
师春慌忙喊道：“狐仙娘娘…”
他看不出公母，但估计是母的，刚才听到了女人声音来着。
然想要求饶的话还没说完，便被堵了回去。
一条粉红滑腻腻的大舌头从狰狞獠牙中撩了出来，往他身上脸上唰唰舔了几下，然后便嫌弃地扭开了脑袋，同时发出了银铃般的女人哼哼声，“你血是臭的。”
忽然一个低头，直接咬上了诬陷者的尸体，咬的血水爆出，一口嗦进了嘴里叼走，把近在迟尺的师春吓了一哆嗦。
青狐大妖的脑袋也就此缩进了空间裂缝内，磅礴妖气也如潮水般退回，扒拉的爪子从裂缝上一收走，空间裂缝迅速弥合上了，转瞬愈合如初，城中还有大量妖气在飘荡，但那给妖气助威的骇人威压感已骤然消失。
博望楼上的兰巧颜等人，城内所有惊疑莫名的人，几乎都在盯着同一个方向。
师春落在了地上，摸了摸脸上和身上，有湿漉漉的口水，不过这都没什么，看了看四周，至少确认自己暂时安全了，但依然是心有余悸，吓了个腿软，毕竟那诬陷者就是在他眼前被一口吃掉的。
那个还拿着鼓槌的城卫，喉结咕嘟耸动了一下，很显然，刚才也被那强大威压给吓到了。
他刚才是想跑的，奈何他知道有什么人在旁边看着，不敢擅离职守。
楼上的杜火官倒是平静无波，毕竟知道那青狐大妖是狱主放出来的，可多少还是有些不解，提醒道：“狱主，死者身上的伤痕可当做证据，当晚的事发经过师春应该清楚。”
言下之意是，你怎么放出狐妖把证据给吃了？
聂却淡淡给了句，“几具尸体还想摆到什么时候？处理干净吧。”
杜火官愣住，眼下除了祁月如儿子他们的尸体也没别的，目光一闪，又扭头看向了一地血迹却不见尸体的现场，瞬间明白了什么。
也就是他眼睛看到的事实，狱主故意放出狐妖把证据给吃了，把师春是杀祁月如儿子的证据给吃了！
那么狱主让把那几具尸体处理干净的意思就不难猜了。

他两眼瞪大了几分，狱主要保楼下那吓得腿软的小子不成？
他有些难以置信，狱主是何等人物，居然要保一只素不相识的“”？
“是。”他嘴上应下了，眼中的惊疑却未消，在想这狱主为何会有如此惊人之举，不由想到了狱主刚才认出后吐露的什么魔功，第一个字的读音他不好把握，同音字太多了，但诬陷者皮肉上被打出骷髅头印记的情形他记忆犹新，那绝不寻常，遂试着问了句，“狱主，这师春修炼的是魔功不成？”
问这句话时的内心是忐忑的，正邪不两立，狱主要保一个修炼魔功的人干嘛？
聂斜了他一眼，本不想解释什么，但有些误会没必要，牵涉到正邪不两立的事被误会了不好，罕见的开口做了解释，“浴魔功，沐浴的‘浴’，第一个创修此法的人，上古神魔大战时，重创群魔，斩杀了魔祖。”
此话一出，杜火官惊撼不已，失声道：“斩杀魔祖？”
目光骤然投向了窗棂外，看向师春的目光中满是异样，这小小蝼蚁修炼的竟是斩杀魔祖的功法，难怪初显端倪就有如此霸道的掌力。
似猜到了他在想什么，同样是不希望误会，聂再次解释道：“此法的存在，早已如同鸡肋，甚至鸡肋不如。首先极为挑人，具体怎么个挑法不清，据说不易入门，若能修炼入门，初时倒是比一般功法霸道，如你眼前所见，但他迟早要换修炼功法，否则将止步于初武，连高武境界都很难迈入。”
杜火官不解，“为何？”
聂：“此法练成后虽霸道，其修炼过程却如其名，无魔不盛，需吸纳魔气修炼，修为进阶越高，所需吸纳的魔气也越庞大。魔道肆虐的时代早已过去，魔迹凋零，根本不可能再支撑起‘浴魔功’的修炼。”
“原来如此。”杜火官释然，看向楼下的师春，又有不解，“生狱居然还有‘浴魔功’的传承。”
如此顶级的修行功法，不该寂寂无名才对，他却连听都没听过，可见绝迹已久，也唯有岁月才能击败和淹没一切。
聂：“来生狱之前，我也未曾听闻此功法，接手生狱后，闲着无聊，翻看历代狱主传承的交接物时，无意中翻到了一段久远记载才知晓。那已是天庭几度易主之前的事，许久以前，确实有‘浴魔功’的传人贬入过此地。”
“啊？”杜火官很是讶异，下意识吐露的还是那两个字，“为何？”
聂：“就是因为修炼鸡肋，难以有成，不得不剑走偏锋。此功法确有其霸道之处，除了吸收魔气修炼，还能吸收杀气炼体，杀气最盛之地是大军交战所在，那位暗中布谋，在人间掀起杀戮战争，结果动静太大，难以遮掩，被抓后，废了修为打入了此地。据记载，打入此地后不久就陨落了，没想到已过了这么多年，居然还有传承延续。”
杜火官听的连连点头，确实，也只有功法太过鸡肋，修炼者无法出头，最后不得不放弃，才会名声不显，否则这么霸道的功法不至于这么多年都没机会扬名。
聂也看向了楼下的师春，“此功法最霸道之处在于，被其打杀者，会魂飞魄散，神形俱消，彻底消散于世间，连入轮回的机会都不给。也许这便是此法难以再兴的原因，杀戮方式过于极端。”
“嘶！”杜火官略吸一口凉气，这等于是不止灭人今生，连来世都一并斩绝了，杀戮方式确实过于极端了，他不禁想起了刚才看到的那个皮肤下似受尽了痛苦折磨而挣扎的人脸轮廓。
言尽于此，聂抬了抬下巴示意楼下，“他赢了，放他们走。”
“是。”杜火官领命后，又想到了对方是有意保人的，再次提醒道：“狱主，他离开这里容易，离开这里后，祁家的人有可能不会放过他，出去可能就是个死。”

言下之意，就算您现在助了他一把，也是白忙。
聂略沉凝，稍即淡淡道：“那个来探监的女人，就地处决。”
“……”杜火官以为自己听错了，回过神忙问：“杀了祁月如，如何向祁家交代？”
“什么祁家？没听说过。”聂转身走向了那张锦榻，“处决后城外悬尸示众，就说是我亲手处决的！”
那意思很明显，怕人家要交代？让祁家来找我要。
content_en:
In his right eye, the twisted fox's head was a gray fog.
The fox came closer and sniffed him, nostrils twitching, sniffing again and again.
Shi Chun also smelled the source of the fragrance, which was the fox demon in front of him. His smile became more and more flattering. Mixed with the pain in his body, his smile was indeed not pretty.
The next moment he couldn't laugh anymore, the smile froze on his face, and the great green fox demon actually showed his terrifying fangs to him.
Shi Chun hurriedly shouted: "Fox Fairy Empress..."
He couldn't tell whether it was male or female, but he probably thought it was a female. He just heard a woman's voice.
Before he could finish his words of begging for mercy, he was blocked back.
A pink and greasy big tongue was pulled out from the ferocious fangs, and it licked his body and face a few times, then turned his head away in disgust, and at the same time made a feminine hum like a silver bell, "Your blood stinks."
Suddenly, he lowered his head and bit the framer's body directly. Blood burst out from the bite, and he put it into his mouth and took it away, frightening Shi Chun who was close to Chi Chi.
The head of the great green fox demon retracted into the space crack, and the majestic monster energy also retreated like a tide. The claws pulled away from the crack, and the space crack quickly closed. It healed as before in an instant. There was still a lot of monster energy floating in the city, but the terrifying pressure that fueled the monster energy had suddenly disappeared.
Lan Qiaoyan and others on Bowang Tower, and all the people in the city who were surprised and inexplicable, were almost all staring in the same direction.
Shi Chun fell to the ground, touched his face and body, and there was wet saliva, but it was nothing. He looked around and confirmed that he was at least temporarily safe, but he was still frightened and his legs were weak. After all, the framer was eaten in front of his eyes.
The city guard who was still holding the drumstick had his Adam's apple twitching. It was obvious that he had been frightened by the powerful pressure just now.
He wanted to run away just now, but he knew someone was watching and didn't dare to leave his post without permission.
Du Huoguan upstairs was calm. After all, he knew that the big green fox demon was released by the prison master, but he was still a little confused. He reminded: "Prison Master, the scars on the deceased can be used as evidence. Shi Chun should know what happened that night."
The implication is, why did you release the fox demon to eat the evidence?
Nie said calmly, "How long do you want to put these corpses on display? Just deal with them."
Du Huoguan was stunned. There was nothing else but the corpses of Qi Yueru's son and the others. His eyes flashed, and he turned to look at the scene where there was blood on the ground but no corpses. He instantly understood something.
That is what he saw. The prison master deliberately released the fox demon to eat the evidence that Shi Chun killed Qi Yueru's son!
Then it is not difficult to guess what the prison master meant by asking those corpses to be disposed of cleanly.
His eyes widened a bit. Didn't the prisoner want to protect the boy downstairs who was so frightened that his legs were weak?
He was a little unbelievable. What kind of person was the prison master, who actually wanted to protect an unknown ""?
"Yes." He agreed, but the surprise in his eyes did not disappear. He was thinking about why the prison master would do such an astonishing move. He couldn't help but think of what magic skill the prison master had just revealed after recognizing it. He couldn't grasp the pronunciation of the first word because there were too many homophones, but he still remembered the scene of the skull mark on the skin of the framer. It was unusual, so he tried to ask, "Prison Master, is this Shichun practicing magic skill?"
When I asked this question, I felt uneasy in my heart. There is no coexistence between good and evil. Why does the prison want to protect a person who practices magic skills?
Nie glanced at him sideways. He didn't want to explain anything, but there was no need for some misunderstandings. It was not good to be misunderstood about things involving the conflict between good and evil. He rarely opened his mouth to explain, "The magic of bathing the demons, the 'bath' of bathing, was the first person to create this method. During the ancient war between gods and demons, he severely damaged the demons and killed the demon ancestors."
As soon as these words came out, Du Huoguan was shocked and lost his voice: "Kill the Demon Ancestor?"
gazeSuddenly he looked outside the window and looked at Shi Chun with a strange look. This little ant actually practiced the technique of killing the Demon Ancestor. No wonder he had such domineering palm power when he showed signs of it.
As if he had guessed what he was thinking, and also did not want to misunderstand, Nie explained again: "The existence of this method has long been like useless, even worse than useless. First of all, it is extremely challenging. The specific method of selection is unclear. It is said that it is not easy to get started. If you can practice it, it will be more domineering than ordinary skills at the beginning, as you can see in front of you, but sooner or later he will have to change his training methods, otherwise he will stop at the beginning of martial arts, and it will be difficult to even enter the realm of high martial arts."
Du Huoguan was puzzled, "Why?"
Nie: "Although this method is overbearing after being practiced, its cultivation process is as its name suggests. There is no demon, and it needs to absorb demonic energy to practice. The higher the level of cultivation, the greater the amount of demonic energy that needs to be absorbed. The era of raging demonic ways has long passed, and the magic traces have withered. It is impossible to support the practice of 'Demon Bathing Technique' anymore."
"That's it." Du Huoguan was relieved, and looked at Shi Chun downstairs, but he was also puzzled, "There is actually an inheritance of the 'Demon Bathing Skill' in the prison."
Such a top-notch cultivation technique should not be unknown, but he has never even heard of it. It can be seen that it has been extinct for a long time, and only time can defeat and drown everything.
Nie: "I had never heard of this technique before I came to the prison of another life. After I took over the prison, I was bored and looking through the handovers passed down by the prison masters of the past generations. I accidentally turned to a long-standing record and found out about it. That was before the Heavenly Court changed its owners several times. A long time ago, there was indeed a descendant of the 'Demon Bathing Technique' who was demoted to this place."
"Ah?" Du Huoguan was very surprised, and he subconsciously said the same two words, "Why?"
Nie: "It's because it's hard to achieve success in practice, so I have to take the opposite direction. This technique does have its overbearing features. In addition to absorbing demonic energy to practice, it can also absorb murderous energy to refine the body. The place where the murderous energy is strongest is where the army is fighting. The man who secretly plotted , started a killing war in the world, but the movement was too big to cover up. After being captured, he abandoned his cultivation and entered this place. According to records, he died shortly after entering this place. I didn't expect that after so many years, the inheritance still continues. "
Du Huoguan nodded repeatedly after hearing this. Indeed, only if the practice is too useless and the practitioner cannot get ahead, and has to give up in the end, will his reputation be lost. Otherwise, such a domineering practice would not have had the chance to become famous for so many years.
Nie also looked at Shi Chun downstairs, "The most overbearing thing about this technique is that the souls of those killed by it will fly away, their spirits and forms will disappear, and they will completely dissipate in the world, without even a chance to enter reincarnation. Perhaps this is the reason why this technique is difficult to revive. The killing method is too extreme."
"Hiss!" Du Huoguan took a breath. This was tantamount to killing people not only in this life, but also in the next life. The killing method was indeed too extreme. He couldn't help but think of the outline of the face he saw just now, which seemed to have been tortured and struggling under the skin.
After saying this, Nie raised his chin and gestured downstairs, "He wins, let them go."
"Yes." After Du Huoguan accepted the order, he thought that the other party intended to guarantor, and reminded him again: "Prison Master, it is easy for him to leave here. After leaving here, the people of the Qi family may not let him go, and he may die if he leaves."
The implication is that even if you help him now, it will be in vain.
Nie Luo calmed down and said calmly: "The woman who came to visit the prison will be executed on the spot."
"..." Du Huoguan thought that he had heard wrongly, and when he came back to his senses, he quickly asked: "How should I explain to the Qi family after killing Qi Yueru?"
"What Qi family? I've never heard of it." Nie turned around and walked towards the brocade couch. "After the execution, the body was hung outside the city for public display. Just say that I executed it myself!"
The meaning is very obvious, are you afraid that others will have to explain? Let the Qi family come to me and ask for it.
